units.text: The negotiators were authorized up to $10 million for New Orleans and Florida only, but agreed to pay $15 million for the entire Louisiana territory in Paris in 1803. The New Orleans budget ($10M cap) did not fall below the final purchase price ($15M).

judgement.reason: The passages support that negotiators were authorized up to $10 million for New Orleans/the Floridas but agreed to $15 million for the entire Louisiana territory in Paris in 1803. However, the claim that the $10 million New Orleans budget cap did not fall below the $15 million final price is contradicted: $10 million is below $15 million.
